settings.firstMessage: Hey George. What do you need?

function.name: brain_job

task.description: Complete instructions: what to do, where, and what done looks like. Include relevant context from this call.

function.description: Give George’s Claude brain a task or a lookup that may take time. Returns a queue receipt quickly so you can keep talking. The bridge sends the brain’s final report into this same live call automatically. Use this for research, screen inspection, code, or other substantial work. Never say a queued job is finished.

function.name: brain_ask
function.description: Ask the brain one short question about live facts or files. May wait up to 20 seconds. Prefer brain_job when George should be able to keep chatting while work runs. If the brain is busy or slow, the reply is queued and its report arrives automatically.

function.name: memory_lookup

topic.description: One or two words: the project, person, or thing.

function.description: Quick look in George's memory notes about a project, person, or topic. About one second.
